guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: For the full year 2026, we are maintaining our top-line guidance. We continue to expect revenue to grow at a low- to mid-teens percentage on a year-over-year basis. We also continue to expect bookings to grow at a low-teens percentage on a year-over-year basis. Growth is anticipated to be driven by Base44’s continued strong growth trajectory through the remainder of the year.

For fourth quarter 2026, we expect revenue to grow at a low-double-digits percentage on a year-over-year basis and expect fourth quarter bookings growth to continue to lag revenue growth as a result of the more immediate impact of Partners softness on bookings.

For full year 2026, we now expect FCF margin excluding acquisition-related and restructuring costs to be approximately 16%, down from the high-teens previously anticipated, primarily due to accelerated sales and marketing investments in Base44. This outlook still assumes Base44 non-GAAP gross margin of approximately 60% in 2H with margin exiting the year above 60%. We expect further gross margin improvement to be reinvested into Base44 sales and marketing in the fourth quarter in order to position ourselves well to capture the continued elevated demand for Base44.

Our aggressive push into marketing is paying off - this is clearly reflected in Base44’s milestone ARR of nearly $250 million today. With the majority of Base44 subscriptions billed monthly and growth expected to ramp through the latter half of the year, we expect the strong ARR momentum this year to gradually translate into bookings and revenue dollars over the coming quarters.
In addition, we expect a working capital headwind in the fourth quarter of ~$10 million related to the prepayment of GPUs required to run our models for the next couple of years.
